description: Contacts Exchange is an address-book service where people collect contact details through private invitation links and export them to Google Contacts or vCard. It also provides an MCP server so AI apps can read a user’s address book, create invitation links, and update the user’s own contact card.
summary: Contacts Exchange exposes one developer integration surface: an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at `https://contacts.exchange/mcp` using streamable HTTP and self-onboarding OAuth 2.1.
